svg.title: Inserted arithmetic and geometric means use the number of transitions
svg.desc: Three inserted arithmetic means between two and eighteen are six, ten, fourteen. Three positive geometric means between two and one hundred sixty two are six, eighteen, fifty four. Each list has five terms and four transitions.

g.text: THREE INSERTED MEANS CREATE FOUR GAPS
Each step multiplies by r=3; r⁴=162/2=81.
Count transitions between endpoints. Keep the positivity condition when choosing a ratio.
